SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. 171
G. L. & H.S. File No.
DATE 30. 11. 30
REPORT
Central Station,
Date December 12th. 1930.

Subject (in full) Report on attached letter.

Made by D. I. Mason. Forwarded by L. Maguire C.I

Sir,
C.D.C. 56 admits having lived with the woman Tsu Shih since
1920. They have had three children, two of whom are dead. The
surviving one is a boy age 3 years. The woman and child reside
at 74 Jung Chih Li, Dent Road. He denies ever having married this
woman, and states that when he informed her of his forthcoming
marriage, she raised no objection, and agreed to accept $18.00
per month for her support.
The chief tenant of the above house for about 6 years was a
man named Wong Toong Zun who is now living in Chapei, and is
employed as a private watchman at the Chinese Telegraph Office,
Foochow Road. The C.D.C. suspects that this man is the cause of
the letter being sent as he had trouble with him over the non
return of a pair of ear-rings which he (Wong) borrowed from the
woman, and failed to return for some considerable time.
The woman has been questioned, and she corroborates the
statement of the C.D.C.

Mason.
D. D. C. "A" 60 A
D. I.

O.S. (air)
13 DEC. 1930

G. L. & H.S. 档案号
日期 30. 11. 30
报告
中央捕房，
日期 1930年12月12日。

主题（全称） 关于所附信函的报告。

由 D. I. Mason 撰写。由督察长 Maguire 转呈

先生，
华籍探目 C.D.C. 56 承认自1920年起便与女子朱氏（Tsu Shih）同居。他们育有三名子女，其中两名已夭折。幸存者为一名3岁男孩。该女子及孩子居住在登特路（Dent Road）荣吉里74号。他否认曾与该女子结婚，并称当他告知即将另娶时，她并未提出异议，并同意接受每月18.00元作为赡养费。
上述房屋的主要租户在约6年间是一名名为 Wong Toong Zun 的男子，此人现居住在闸北，受雇于福州路中国电报局，担任私人看守。该华籍探目怀疑此信系由该男子寄出，因为他曾与该男子就一对耳环发生纠纷；该男子（Wong）从该女子处借走耳环后，相当长一段时间内未予归还。
经讯问该女子，其证词证实了该华籍探目的陈述。

Mason.
副华籍探目 "A" 60 A
侦探巡长。

O.S. (航空)

Translation of the attached anonymous letter; address on
the envelope: No.8 Chaofeong Road, Li.

December 4, 1930.

President Yang Shao-shun,
Shanghai Special Area District Court.

Sir,

In view of the fairness and justice displayed by
you in your former capacity of President of the District
Court as well as of the Court of Procuration in the
interior we learn with great pleasure that you have now
become President of the Shanghai Special Area District
Court.

Your attention is drawn to the malpractices on the
part of C.D.C. Tsang Shiao-ling (張筱林) attached to the
Foochow Road Police Station in the British Settlement,
who makes use of his influence as a public officer to swell
his own pockets.

Tsang Shiao-ling was married years ago. His wife
Tsu Shih is a good woman and has born 4 children who died
one after another with the exception of one boy, the only
child they now have.

On November 10 in the Siao Yu Tien Restaurant at North
Szechuen Road C.D.C. Tsang Shiao-ling married a concubine,
and prior to the wedding feast he had a large number of
invitations sent out to businessmen in order to exact money
from them. In marrying a second time C.D.C. Tsang Shiao-
ling has been guilty of bigamy and contravention of a
judicial order.

What is worse of all is that he has discarded his wife
and child.

His wife at present resides at No.74 Zung Chi Li off
Dent Road, and his concubine at No.1036 Ih Sing Fong off
Wuchow Road. It is therefore requested that the Judicial
Police be detailed to make an investigation into the case.

(Unsigned).

（左侧手写批注：C.D.C. (二) ... Permission was granted for this ... Some ...）

1930年12月4日。

杨绍顺院长，
上海特区地方法院。

先生，

鉴于您此前在内地担任地方法院院长及检察厅厅长期间所展现的公平与正义，我们获悉您现已出任上海特区地方法院院长，深感欣慰。

现提请阁下注意英租界福州路捕房所属华籍探目张筱林（Tsang Shiao-ling）的不法行为，他利用公职人员的影响力中饱私囊。

张筱林多年前已婚。其妻朱氏（Tsu Shih）是一位贤良女子，共生育4名子女，除目前唯一存活的一名男孩外，其余均相继夭折。

11月10日，华籍探目张筱林在北四川路小雅天餐厅纳妾，并在婚宴之前向众多商人发出大量请柬，意在向他们勒索钱财。张筱林探目再次结婚，犯有重婚罪，并违反了司法命令。

更糟糕的是，他抛弃了妻子和孩子。

其妻现居住在登特路（Dent Road）旁荣吉里74号，其妾居住在梧州路（Wuchow Road）旁怡兴坊1036号。因此，恳请派遣司法警察对此案进行调查。

（未署名）。

（左侧手写批注：华籍探目 (二) ... 已获准为此... 一些...）
